reviews.title: Solid case
reviews.comment:
Sweet case, great design, and easy to build in.
Biggest issue I had was, although Rufus insisted it was compatible with mobos with back connectors, it definitely was not. Was worth the few hours cutting everything out with a dremel though and made for a very clean final product.
Temps have been great, liquid AIO on a 9800x3d and I sit stable around 60° in game, have yet to see GPU go anywhere above that too. I currently have it set up on 50/50 intake exhaust, but I may swap the rear fan for intake to keep positive case pressure. I do worry this will effect cooling performance as the only way (from what I can tell) of having positive case pressure, is by having the rear intake and top exhaust fans right next to each other.
Otherwise great case design and the ability to house a full size ATX power supply is a huge plus. Would definitely buy again

reviews.title: Beautiful panoramic m-atx case
reviews.comment: Beautiful case with a solid build quality especially for price category. Very easy to build in. Top fan mount is just enough to fit 3 120mm fans and will not fit most 360mm aio radiators. led screen comes with link to down load driver and runs off USB header. Quality of design is focused on function, front glass and rear panels easily align snap in, and are secured with thumb screws
